import json, os
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

paths = [
    Path("/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl"),
    Path.home()/"Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl",
    Path("/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl"),
]
day = "2026-10-17"
for p in paths:
    print("\n===== ", p, "exists", p.exists(), "=====")
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    n = 0
    with p.open() as f:
        for line in f:
            if day not in line:
                continue
            n += 1
            try:
                o = json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                print(line[:300])
                continue
            # compact
            keys = list(o.keys())[:12]
            ts = o.get("ts") or o.get("time") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("at") or ""
            src = o.get("source") or o.get("kind") or o.get("from") or ""
            text = o.get("text") or o.get("content") or o.get("prompt") or o.get("summary") or o.get("message") or ""
            if isinstance(text, dict):
                text = json.dumps(text, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]
            else:
                text = str(text)[:400]
            bid = o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("reply_to_bus_id") or ""
            print(f"--- n={n} ts={ts} src={src} bus={bid} keys={keys}")
            print(text.replace("\n"," ")[:500])
            if n >= 40:
                print("...truncated")
                break
    print("count_shown", n)
PY
